title: Workflow definition
description: One checked-in workflow per file at .seed/workflows/<name>.yaml (design §7.3 + inspirations/04 SYNTHESIS). The engine's `seed workflow validate` enforces this contract plus twelve semantic rules (unique kebab-case ids, DAG acyclicity, prompt XOR, referenced files, artifact closure, role closure, the harness/model registry, budget sanity, loop requirements, token lint, optional adapter checks). Unknown fields fail validation. `tools` maps onto the harness contract's SEED_PERMISSION: readonly → read-only, coding → safe-edit (the default); yolo is NOT reachable from a workflow file. Run state lives under <git-common-dir>/seed-runs/<run-id>/ — local, never committed.

id.description: Unique kebab-case id; depends_on is BY ID, never index

prompt.description: Exactly one of prompt | prompt_file | run (gate-only and loop steps carry none)

run.description: Deterministic command; executed with SEED_RUN_DIR set. Under --mock it is recorded, never executed

tools.description: readonly → SEED_PERMISSION=read-only; coding → safe-edit (default). No value maps to yolo

output_format.description: Inline JSON Schema enforced on the step's FIRST produce after it runs

consumes.description: Artifact names; each must be produced by a step reachable through depends_on

file.description: Path relative to the run directory (conventionally artifacts/...)

schema.description: JSON Schema file relative to .seed/workflows/, enforced on the produced file

when.description: Minimal grammar: steps.<id>.outcome == 'x' | inputs.<name> == 'v' (and !=); unparseable expressions skip the step

max_iterations.description: Loop groups: required with until + steps

until.description: Loop exit condition: a command whose exit 0 ends the loop

steps.description: Loop body, run in declared order each iteration

gate.description: Guards the step that carries it; runs BEFORE the step's own action. Under --mock every gate auto-passes (and the run report says so)

message.description: approval: shown while the run is paused

capture_response.description: approval: record the response file with the run's gate records

reviewer_role.description: review: the reviewing role (read-only harness call returning APPROVE|APPROVE_WITH_NOTES|REVISE)

remediation.description: review: REQUIRED — the coding-role step run on every REVISE before the reviewer re-runs (never re-review an unchanged implementation)

required_ci.description: checks: require completed+green check runs on ref (REST)

unresolved_threads.description: checks: maximum unresolved review threads on pr (GraphQL review-thread query)

ref.description: checks: commit ref for check runs

pr.description: checks: PR number for the thread query
